difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 8.4.4 at source lines 1001-1008, in three parts: the fiber of the first map of the fiber sequence is Omega Y, the fiber of the second is Omega X, and under these equivalences the third map is identified with Omega f composed with path reversal. The author's proof (source lines 1009-1028) is a computation rather than a citation: it unpacks the fiber as a triple and reassociates the sigma types (lines 1011-1014), contracts one component to reduce the type to y_0 = y_0 (lines 1015-1017), and then works out the resulting equivalence explicitly, checking both that it sends ((x,p),q) to opp(f_0) `ct` ap f (opp q) `ct` p and that it preserves basepoints so that it is a map of pointed types (lines 1018-1021). Part (2) is an iteration, and part (3) requires following f^(3) through the identification of f^(2) (lines 1022-1028). The statement gives the three equivalences without any of the explicit formulas.
